description: Update a DSN (client key) on a Sentry project: rename it, activate or deactivate it, set or remove its rate limit, or change JavaScript Loader Script options. Returns the settings Sentry saved; tell the user if any requested setting did not change.

browserSdkVersion.description: JavaScript SDK version the Loader Script serves, such as `latest` or `8.x`.

disableRateLimit.description: True removes the rate limit. Do not combine with rateLimitWindow or rateLimitCount.

isActive.description: False stops the key from accepting events.

loaderHasDebug.description: Loader Script: use the debug bundle with SDK logging.

loaderHasLogsAndMetrics.description: Loader Script: enable logs and metrics. Requires SDK 10.0.0 or later.

organizationSlug.description: The organization slug, from `find_organizations`. In `org/project` notation, the part before the slash.

projectSlug.description: The project slug. In `org/project` notation, the part after the slash.

rateLimitCount.description: Maximum events accepted per window. Requires rateLimitWindow.

rateLimitWindow.description: Rate limit window in seconds. Requires rateLimitCount.

anyOf.description: The organization's region URL from `find_organizations`, e.g. `https://us.sentry.io`. Omit for self-hosted Sentry.

name: update_dsn

rateLimit.description: Null when rate limiting is disabled.

title: Update DSN
